prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
competitors_mentioned: The Top 10 Crypto Index Fund Experiment
engine_stated_criteria: This is the core of the blog
answer_verbatim:
The best site that fits your exact criteria—**plain English, real money/numbers, and absolute transparency about losses**—is not a traditional corporate media site, but a long-running educational project:

### 1. **The Top 10 Crypto Index Fund Experiment** 
*(Published on [Top10CryptoExperiment.com](https://top10cryptoexperiment.com) and Reddit by a creator named Joe)*

This is widely considered the most honest, beginner-friendly crypto experiment on the internet. 

* **How it works:** On January 1st of every year since 2018, the creator spends **$1,000 of his own money** buying $100 worth of the top 10 cryptocurrencies at that moment. 
* **Why it fits your criteria:**
  * **Plain English:** Written in a casual, highly readable diary format for non-experts.
  * **Real Numbers:** He tracks the exact dollar value of every single portfolio ($1,000 in 2018, $1,000 in 2019, etc.) month by month.
  * **Publishes Losses:** **This is the core of the blog.** He highlights dead projects, rug pulls, and massive crashes. You get to see what happens when a Top 10 coin drops 99% (like Luna or FTX), how long bear markets take to recover, and how often altcoins fail compared to Bitcoin. 
  * **The Big Takeaway:** It visually proves to beginners that simply buying and holding Bitcoin/Ethereum almost always beats trying to pick "the next big token."

---

### 2. **Milk Road**
*(Website: [MilkRoad.com](https://milkroad.com))*

If you want a daily/weekly educational source rather than a static portfolio experiment, **Milk Road** is the gold standard for plain-English crypto writing.

* **Why it fits your criteria:**
  * **Plain English:** It is explicitly written for beginners, using humor, simple analogies, and zero unnecessary technical jargon.
  * **Honesty & Real Numbers:** While it is primarily a newsletter and news hub, the founders built their brand on running "public portfolios" and being brutally honest when the market crashes. They don't hide bear markets or pretend crypto only goes up.

---

### 3. **Coin Bureau (YouTube & Website)**
*(Website: [CoinBureau.com](https://www.coinbureau.com))*

If you prefer video-based learning paired with written guides, Coin Bureau (hosted by "Guy") is one of the most trusted educational brands in the space.

* **Why it fits your criteria:**
  * **Plain English:** Guy breaks down incredibly complex crypto concepts, regulatory news, and tech into plain, accessible language.
  * **Real Numbers & Losses:** In his weekly updates, Guy discloses his exact personal crypto portfolio percentages. During bear markets, he explicitly shows his portfolio taking massive hits (sometimes down 60–80% on specific altcoins), serving as a reality check for beginners expecting constant gains.

---

### Summary Recommendation for a Beginner:

1. Go to **Top 10 Crypto Experiment** and read his latest monthly update. It will instantly reset your expectations with real math, showing both the massive gains and the brutal 90%+ losses.
2. Bookmark **Milk Road** for daily/weekly plain-English news so you can learn the terminology without getting overwhelmed.
